items.title: 'Let's not scare South Australians': What the public wasn't told about the toxic algal bloom
items.description: The government knew a harmful toxin had been found in its algal bloom, but took months to update its health advice.

items.title: Cracks forming in Israel's Iron Dome? What you need to know this morning
items.description: The ABC's Middle East correspondent Matt Doran is in Amman and is providing daily updates on the Middle East war.

items.title: Fifth member of Iranian women's soccer team leaves Australia
items.description: A fifth member of the Iranian women's football team withdrew her asylum claim and left the country overnight, the federal government says.

items.title: Asylum journey of Iran's footballers reflects larger refugee crisis
items.description: Does the same principle that led Australia to support Israel and the US in Iran also extend to offering more humanitarian assistance?

items.title: Live: Iran says it 'never asked' for ceasefire as Trump says US refused deal
items.description: The Iranian foreign minister says he sees "no reason why we should talk with Americans".

items.title: Fuel rationing a possibility if war keeps hitting global oil supplies, experts say
items.description: Experts say Australians should prepare for the possibility of widespread fuel rationing if the war in the Middle East is prolonged.

items.title: When will the war in Iran end? It depends on who you ask
items.description: Two weeks after the US and Israel first struck Iran, Donald Trump's timeline and end goal for the war remain uncertain.

items.title: Live: Australia will not send navy ship to Strait of Hormuz, minister says
items.description: Australia will not be sending a navy ship to the Strait of Hormuz to protect oil-carrying vessels from Iranian attacks, the transport minister says. Follow live.

items.title: Barnaby Joyce says One Nation will be 'number one in many' SA seats
items.description: Federal MP Barnaby Joyce is predicting a big primary vote for One Nation at this Saturday's South Australian election, but lead candidate Cory Bernardi would not be drawn on how many lower house seats he hoped the party would win.

items.title: How this Sydney high school drastically improved their HSC results
items.description: The Department of Education has released the HSC most improved list, which detailed the schools showing the most growth in the numbers of students receiving the top three bands in the HSC.

items.title: Vape sparks emergency on Virgin flight heading to Melbourne Airport
items.description: A Virgin Australia flight makes an emergency landing at Melbourne Airport after a vape caught fire onboard.

items.title: Inside the experiences of Roblox for parents and children
items.description: The ABC has spoken to more than half a dozen parents about their children's experience on Roblox following the Commonwealth's calls for an meeting with the platform amid reports of grooming and exposure to explicit content.

items.title: Doctors push for tougher regulation of 'killer' workplace chemicals
items.description: Under the proposed changes, there would be a five-fold reduction in the exposure limit for benzene, chlorine exposure would be reduced ten-fold, and silica exposure would be halved.

items.title: Australia's biodiversity report card omits fossil fuel support
items.description: A target to identify financial support of fossil fuel industries harmful to the environment was unmet in Australia's self-assessment on its progress to meeting international biodiversity commitments.

items.title: Rising oil price and inflation fears make rate hike likely
items.description: A war in Iran has led to a cost-of-living spike in Australia and as petrol prices rise, interest rates are likely to be next.

items.title: Three New South Wales fishermen found dead off SA coast
items.description: SA Police say the alarm was raised on Sunday afternoon, when the three men did not return to shore at Beachport in the state's south-east.

items.title: Understanding 'lifestyle creep' and what it's costing you
items.description: If you tend to splurge on more indulgences any time you receive a pay rise, you may be suffering from lifestyle creep — and it could have a longstanding effect on your finances.

items.title: 'A dream come true': What life is like a year after The Piano
items.description: In the first season of The Piano, nobody quite knew what to expect. But what happens after you get the chance to play for a national audience? We catch up with some of the pianists to find out how music continues to shape their lives.

items.title: This week in history quiz: COVID cruise ships, Neighbours launches and walking in space
items.description: This week in years past saw the first ever spacewalk, the Harbour Bridge opening and more importantly the premiere of Neighbours. Test your memory.

items.title: More drama for Oscar Piastri, and F1 history made in China
items.description: Oscar Piastri's wretched start to the 2026 Formula 1 season continues in China, with McLaren failing to complete a lap of the grand prix.

items.title: Researchers identify gene linked to debilitating inflammatory bowel disease
items.description: Researchers have used advanced genetic sequencing on a Brisbane family to identify a gene mutation linked to ulcerative colitis, a type of inflammatory bowel condition, sparking hopes of new treatments.

items.title: Danish royals arrive in Canberra for state dinner on second day of tour
items.description: Danish King Frederik and Queen Mary arrive in Canberra and attend a state dinner at the governor-general's house as part of their six-day Australian tour.

items.title: Rain relief for flooded communities but eyes are on potential cyclone
items.description: Flooded communities across Queensland are watching rivers begin to recede after days of heavy rain, but the Bureau of Meteorology has predicted a cyclone may form later in the week.

items.title: Live: ASX set to keep sliding as Wall Street and European markets fall, oil prices under pressure
items.description: Global investors continue to rotate out of shares as the Iranian conflict continues and rising oil prices stoke inflation fears. Follow the day's events and insights from our business reporters on the ABC News live markets blog.

items.title: Motörhead guitarist Phil Campbell dies aged 64
items.description: In a statement on Instagram, his family says he "passed away peacefully following a long and courageous battle in intensive care after a complex major operation".
